# Ignore Visual Studio temporary files, build results, and
# files generated by popular Visual Studio add-ons.

## Ignore Visual Studio cache and settings
.vs/
*.suo
*.user
*.userosscache
*.sln.docstates

## Build results
[Bb]in/
[Oo]bj/
[Ll]og/
[Tt]emp/
[Tt]mp/

## Visual Studio Code directories
.vscode/
*.code-workspace

## Generated files
*.dbmdl
*.bak
*.log
*.vsidx
*.db
*.opendb
*.VC.db
*.pidb
*.svclog

## NuGet packages
*.nupkg
*.snupkg

*.nuget.props
*.nuget.targets
packages/
*.lock.json
